citations.narrative:
At the time of the inspection the licensee’s acquisition and disposition records were not up to date for the animals
currently on hand and inspected during the inspection. Some of the discrepancies are as follows:
- The inventory for the Grevy’s Zebra showed 1 adult animal, but 2 adult animals were present.
- The date of disposition for the Yak is not recorded.
- The inventory for the Brindled Wildebeest showed 1 adult animal, but 4 adult animals were present. There is also not a
name or address for the persons whom the Wildebeest were acquired from.
- The Red Kangaroo observed on inspection was not documented on the record.
- The date of acquisition for several animals is missing.
- Young fallow deer that were reported as having been born and sold over the course of the year were not recorded.
Correct recordkeeping is necessary to properly identify animal held and to accurately trace animals that are sold or
disposed of to ensure their legal acquisition, health, and humane transportation.
Every dealer shall make, keep, and maintain records or forms which fully and correctly disclose acquisition and
disposition information regarding animals purchased or otherwise acquired, owned, held, leased, or otherwise in his or her
possession or under his or her control, or which is transported, sold, euthanized, or otherwise disposed of by the dealer.
Correct by November 18, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
